name: D3 drop the shutdown-ACTIVE check, keep only the generation
D4 teardown clears the whole registry unconditionally
note: OPEN FINDING (defence-in-depth). With the shutdown-ACTIVE check in place nothing can REGISTER during teardown, so an unconditional clear() has nothing extra to erase. The guard covers a state that is currently unreachable by construction. Kept because the reachability argument depends on another guard staying correct — but no test covers it, and that is stated rather than hidden.

name: D5 stale pending branch deletes without re-reading the key
note: OPEN FINDING (defence-in-depth). Same reason as D4: a pending start completing during teardown now releases itself and deletes its own key, so the re-read finds no replacement and the entry=current branch is unreachable.
